_documentation.purpose: Test ordinary and link-parallel-transport coarse-exterior representations on the centered early-time 150 nm reference, isolated from production solvers.
_documentation.relies_on: Reads one completed overnight checkpoint and its exact base simulation configuration. It reconstructs coarse samples onto the fine grid solely for comparison.
_documentation.limitations: This is not yet an evolving AMR solver and cannot demonstrate wall-clock acceleration. Raw complex-field interpolation is assessed using gauge-covariant link-phase errors; production coarse/fine transfer still requires a conservative gauge-covariant operator.

fields.source_run_directory: Result directory containing state.json and its retained checkpoint.
fields.simulation_config: Base simulation used to recover mesh and TDGL normalization.
fields.coarse_factor: Ratio of coarse to fine grid spacing; must divide nx-1 and ny-1.
fields.fine_patch_radius_m: Radius retained exactly around the checkpoint vortex center.
fields.transition_width_m: Cosine-blended comparison band outside the exact fine patch.
fields.output_subdirectory: Directory created inside the source result directory.
